plugins.name: Go Support
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: Go support for the Viva preview: code intelligence through your own gopls, Go Modules build, vet, test and run entries for main packages, Delve debugging, and a Go module in New Project. Missing gopls or dlv can be installed from the plugin details.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 适用于 Viva 预览版的 Go 支持：用你自己的 gopls 提供代码智能，Go Modules 的构建、检查、测试和 main 包运行入口，Delve 调试，以及「新建项目」里的 Go 模块。缺少 gopls 或 dlv 时可以在插件详情里安装。

plugins.name: Gradle
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: Gradle integration for Lithe Desktop: project and task trees, JavaExec applications, builds, tests, compiler diagnostics and dependency trees, with per-module bytecode and local JAR settings. Requires Gradle 7.6+ and compatible Java; new compiler settings require Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 or a compatible AutoBuild. Install Java Support for Java language features.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 适用于 Lithe Desktop 的 Gradle 集成：项目与任务树、JavaExec 应用、构建、测试、编译诊断和依赖树，支持模块字节码与本地 JAR 设置。需要 Gradle 7.6+ 与兼容的 Java；新编译设置需 Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 或兼容的 AutoBuild，Java 语言功能请同时安装 Java Support。

plugins.name: Java Support Lite
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: The lightweight edition of Java Support, without JDT LS: go to definition, find references and the document outline, into the JDK and dependency jars, in about 60-90 MiB of memory. Use either this or Java Support; enabling one turns the other off.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: Java Support 的轻量版，不依赖 JDT LS：跳转到定义、查找引用、文档结构，能跳进 JDK 和依赖库，常驻内存约 60–90 MiB。与 Java Support 二选一，启用其中一个会自动停用另一个。

plugins.name: Java Support
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: Full Java support on the Eclipse JDT Language Server you install (Homebrew jdtls, mason.nvim, Scoop or the VS Code Java extension), run with a JDK 21 or later: completion, diagnostics, navigation, run, debug, tests and Spring Boot / MyBatis indexing. From 3.0.0 JDT LS and its JDK are no longer bundled; the package is about 12 MiB. Projects without Maven or Gradle are recognised too: Eclipse WTP/MyEclipse, IntelliJ IDEA modules and libraries, and WEB-INF/lib web folders with a Tomcat servlet container. From 4.0.0 a Project Structure page edits each Eclipse module's source folders, output, JRE and dependencies (JARs, libraries, other modules) in .classpath, after IntelliJ IDEA. Native project/module bytecode settings require Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 or a compatible AutoBuild; the Project Structure page needs a newer host, and older hosts are offered 3.0.1. For navigation only, choose Java Support Lite. Use either this or Lite; enabling one disables the other.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 基于你自己安装的 Eclipse JDT 语言服务器（Homebrew jdtls、mason.nvim、Scoop 或 VS Code Java 扩展）的完整 Java 支持，需要 JDK 21 或更新版本来运行它：补全、诊断、导航、运行、调试、测试，以及 Spring Boot / MyBatis 索引。3.0.0 起不再附带 JDT LS 和 JDK，安装包约 12 MiB。没有 Maven/Gradle 的项目也能识别：Eclipse WTP/MyEclipse、IntelliJ IDEA 的模块和库，以及带 Tomcat Servlet 容器的 WEB-INF/lib 网页工程。4.0.0 起提供对标 IDEA 的“项目结构”页，按模块编辑 Eclipse 工程的源文件夹、输出、JRE 和依赖（JAR、库、其他模块）并写回 .classpath。项目/模块字节码设置需 Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 或兼容的 AutoBuild；项目结构页需要更新的宿主，旧宿主会继续获得 3.0.1。只需跳转可选 Java Support Lite，两者二选一，启用其中一个会停用另一个。

plugins.name: LLDB Debugger
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: LLDB debugger for the Viva preview: debug C, C++, Objective-C, Swift and Rust through your own lldb-dap, with breakpoints, stepping, variables and an lldb console with completion. macOS only; uses lldb-dap from the Xcode Command Line Tools, and a missing lldb-dap can be installed with Homebrew from the plugin details.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 适用于 Viva 预览版的 LLDB 调试器：通过你电脑上的 lldb-dap 调试 C、C++、Objective-C、Swift 和 Rust，支持断点、单步、变量，以及带补全的 lldb 控制台。仅支持 macOS，使用 Xcode 命令行工具自带的 lldb-dap；缺少时可以在插件详情里用 Homebrew 安装。

plugins.name: Maven
plugins.author: Lithe Community
plugins.description: Maven integration for Lithe Desktop: project and goal trees, profiles, builds, tests, compiler diagnostics and dependency trees, with per-module bytecode and local JAR settings. New compiler settings require Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 or a compatible AutoBuild. Install Java Support for Java completion, run and debug.

localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 适用于 Lithe Desktop 的 Maven 集成：项目与目标树、Profiles、构建、测试、编译诊断和依赖树，支持模块字节码与本地 JAR 设置。新编译设置需 Lithe Desktop 0.8.0 或兼容的 AutoBuild；Java 补全、运行与调试请同时安装 Java Support。
